content.comment_body: Hello, I am working with a [product_name] [version_no] starter kit and facing a similar issue. When trying to transfer my program to the PC, I receive a message: "The IP addresses of your PC and the target [product_name] are not in the same subnet. The application will try to add an additional local IP address. Do you want to continue?" Choosing "no" does not resolve the connection problem. Any advice or troubleshooting suggestions? I am using Windows 7 64-bit, [product_name] [version_no], and have a direct cable connection to the [product_name]. Thanks.

More details are needed to assist you. Is your [product_name] directly connected to the PC, or routed through a network device? If using a router, what are the IP address and subnet mask settings for the router? Please also provide the IP address and subnet mask for both your PC and the [product_name].

Hello, this indicates that your PC cannot detect the [product_name]. For example, if your PC has an IP address of 192.168.0.10 and a subnet mask of 255.255.255.0, it can communicate with devices in the 192.168.0.0 – 192.168.0.255 range. Adjusting the subnet mask broadens the accessible range. If the [product_name] uses an IP outside this range, your PC will not see it. To resolve this: (1) Change the IP address of your PC or the [product_name], or (2) respond "YES" to the message. This may allow your PC's network adapter to acquire a secondary IP address matching the range of the [product_name]. [user_name]

The issue has been resolved using the network configuration examples provided by [user_name]. Thanks to everyone for sharing helpful advice on the forums! Additionally, updating the Ethernet card driver was necessary. I am using a Lenovo Thinkpad T450 with Windows 7 64-bit, and the PC is directly connected to the [product_name]. Cheers!

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience connectivity problems when transferring programs between a [product_name] [version_no] starter kit and a PC, often due to incorrect IP address or subnet settings. The error message is informative but some users remain unsure about how to proceed. Detailed troubleshooting advice and explanations of networking settings, as well as driver updates, are valued for solving these issues.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect smooth and reliable communication between the [product_name] [version_no] module and their PC for program transfers. They seek practical guidance and clear instructions to navigate and resolve network configuration difficulties.
